# Update this file in the same commit as the change that alters it.

match files={".gitignore":"a\\/b\n"} path="a/b" dir=false git=true lib=false

match-icase files={".gitignore":"*.LOG\n" "Sub/.gitignore":"!x.log\n"} path="SUB/x.log" dir=false git=true lib=false
match-icase files={".gitignore":"/[--a]\n"} path="b" dir=false git=true lib=false

match-icase files={".gitignore":"/[--a]\n"} path="x/-" dir=true git=true lib=false
match-icase files={".gitignore":"/[--a]\n"} path="x/-/#a" dir=false git=true lib=false
match-icase files={".gitignore":"[!A]x\n"} path="Ax" dir=false git=true lib=false
